properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed credential material in test fixtures: GCP service-account JSONs (project 'tink-test-infrastructure', private_key_id 'some_bad_private_key_id') embedding an RSA-1024 private key, plus PEM RSA private keys inlined in PEM-reader tests. Dummy credentials for Tink's KMS/PEM integration tests — changeable here (could be generated at test time), but genuinely hardcoded key material shipped in the repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Java JCE raw-block-cipher idiom: 'AES/ECB/NoPadding' instantiates the bare AES block cipher used internally by CMAC (PrfAesCmac, ChunkedAesCmacComputation), EAX (AesEaxJce) and AES key-wrap-with-padding (Kwp) — no ECB encryption of user data. The two 'RSA/ECB/NoPadding' sites are raw unpadded RSA-2048 in the (deprecated) RsaKem hybrid encrypt/decrypt — genuinely unpadded RSA modular exponentiation, Shor-vulnerable, KDF-wrapped afterwards. Library surface, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hvac.Client(..., verify=False) in Python HashiCorp Vault KMS integration tests: TLS certificate verification disabled against the local dev Vault URI. Test-only posture control; the shipped production integrations configure TLS properly. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's own hash-type registries: cc/internal/md_util.cc:40 maps HashType::SHA1 to BoringSSL EVP_sha1(), go/subtle/subtle.go:90 returns crypto/sha1.New; remaining sites test those mappings. SHA-1 is collision-broken and Grover-weakened; the shipped library exposes it only for legacy key managers (legacy HMAC-SHA1, JWT legacy). Library API surface — changeable here, retained deliberately.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test deliberately generates an undersized RSA-1024 key (rsaShortModulusKey) to assert the RSASSA-PKCS1 signer/verifier rejects keys below 2048 bits. Never protects data; documents the library minimum key size. Test fixture, non-production.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 one-time authenticator core of the ChaCha20-Poly1305/XChaCha20-Poly1305 AEADs (and the standalone Poly1305 MAC) — symmetric MAC, Grover-only. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: math/rand usage in Go test files (random test inputs — benign) plus one production site: go/jwt/jwk_converter.go:49 rand.Uint32() mints a JWK key ID (kid) — a public, non-secret identifier; predictability is tolerable but crypto/rand would be preferable in shipped code. Java sites flagged are Tink subtle.Random ('Random.randBytes') and 'Random rand = new SecureRandom()' (RsaKem) — SecureRandom-backed name collisions, actually secure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: No finite-field DSA primitive exists in this repository. Every inspected site is a substring collision on 'DSA' inside Ecdsa* (EcdsaPrivateKey protos/type URLs), SlhDsa* (SLH-DSA PQ signature) and EdDSA/Ed25519 identifiers — the underlying assets are recorded under ALG-710f61f0 (ECDSA), ALG-64af9e41 (SLH-DSA) and ALG-5e08bdf5 (Ed25519). Retained only to avoid deleting those sites; no distinct DSA asset exists here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's shipped RSA surface across cc/go/java: RSASSA-PKCS1 and RSASSA-PSS key managers and signers (cc/internal/rsa_util.cc, go/internal/signature/rsassapkcs1+rsassapss), RSA-KEM hybrid (java hybrid/subtle, raw RSA-2048), JWT RS256/PS256, PEM parsing; 2048-bit minimum enforced. All Shor-vulnerable — signatures migrate to ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA, RSA-KEM to ML-KEM-768. Library surface, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's MAC/PRF surface: AES-CMAC key managers and implementations (go/mac/subtle/cmac.go, java PrfAesCmac/ChunkedAesCmacComputation, cc CMAC tests in keyset builders) and the GMAC/POLYVAL core of AES-GCM-SIV. Symmetric MACs — only Grover-weakened, not Shor-broken. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's JWT RSA signing surface: jwt_rsa_ssa_pkcs1 (RS256) and jwt_rsa_ssa_pss (PS256) key managers, JWK converters and format handling across cc/go/java. RSA-based JWT signatures are Shor-vulnerable (harvest-now-verify-later for issued tokens); migrate to ML-DSA-65-based JWTs when available. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's JWT HS256 (HMAC-SHA-256) key managers (cc/jwt/internal/jwt_hmac_key_manager.h, Go/Java counterparts, format tests). Symmetric MAC — quantum impact limited to Grover's quadratic speedup; 256-bit tags retain adequate security. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Legacy HMAC-SHA-1 retained for decrypting/verifying old keysets (java LegacyAesCtrHmacTestKeyManager, cc/go legacy AES-CTR-HMAC streaming primitives, HybridUtil parameter checks). Tink labels HMAC-SHA1 insecure for new keys; kept only for compatibility. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Streaming/legacy modes: AES-CTR key managers and implementations (cc/internal/aes_util.cc:80 EVP CTR, go aes_ctr.go, java AesCtrJceCipher, AesCtrHmacStreaming), CFB/OFB registry support in md/hash utilities. Bare CTR is malleable without authentication — Tink always pairs it with HMAC and marks standalone CTR insecure; kept for legacy keysets. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Fixed nonces/IVs in known-answer test vectors: RFC 9180 HPKE test vectors in go/hybrid/internal/hpke/hpke_test.go (baseNonce "56d890e5accaaf011cff4b7d" and sequential nonce values) and fixed IVs in Java AES-CTR cipher tests. Required for deterministic KAT verification; no production static-IV usage. Test fixtures, intentional.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Production site: cc/integration/gcpkms/gcp_kms_public_key_sign.cc:92 accepts Cloud KMS CryptoKeyVersions of type EC_SIGN_SECP256K1_SHA256 — Tink verifies secp256k1 signatures produced by GCP KMS (vendor-controlled algorithm choice; Tink merely supports it). Other sites are negative tests proving Tink's own PEM parser/keyset reader rejects secp256k1. secp256k1 is Shor-vulnerable like all EC curves.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSASSA-PSS signer/verifier key managers (go/internal/signature/rsassapss_signer.go:64, rsassapss_verifier.go:64 and cc/java equivalents). Shor-vulnerable RSA signatures; migrate to ML-DSA-65 or SLH-DSA. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CBC block-cipher path in cc/internal/aes_util.cc:93 (BoringSSL EVP CBC) plus its unit test; used only by internal/legacy paths — no shipped recommended template uses unauthenticated CBC. Malleable without a MAC; library surface retained for compatibility.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Hash-type registry entry mapping HashType::SHA224 to the OpenSSL implementation (cc/internal/md_util.cc:42) plus test; legacy compatibility only, no recommended template uses SHA-224. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RFC 9180 (HPKE) published known-answer test vectors: static sender/receiver private keys and secrets in go/hybrid/internal/hpke/hpke_test.go:105-107. Test fixtures required for KAT verification; not production secrets.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's Ed25519 signature surface: key managers, key templates, and subtle sign/verify implementations across cc/go/java (plus extensive tests). EdDSA over Curve25519 is Shor-vulnerable (discrete log); migrate to ML-DSA-65 or SLH-DSA. Library surface, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's X25519 key-agreement surface: ECIES/HPKE hybrid encryption (ephemeral X25519 + HKDF + AEAD), the classical half of the experimental CECPQ2 hybrid KEM (X25519+HRSS-708), and key templates/tests across cc/go/java. X25519 ECDH is Shor-vulnerable — captured hybrid-encryption ciphertexts are harvest-now-decrypt-later; migrate to ML-KEM-768 (ideally hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768). Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256/secp256r1 support: ECIES parameters (cc/hybrid/ecies_parameters.cc:41), key templates, JWT ES256 signers. Shor-vulnerable like all elliptic curves. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's JWT ES256 (ECDSA P-256 + SHA-256) key managers and JWK conversion (cc/jwt/internal/jwt_ecdsa_verify_key_manager.cc:87, cc/jwt/jwk_set_converter.cc:294). Shor-vulnerable JWT signatures; migrate to ML-DSA-based JWTs when standardized. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's ECDSA surface: key managers/templates across languages, subtle signers/verifiers (cc/hybrid/ecies_private_key.cc, hpke_private_key.cc references), the committed example keyset (cc/examples/digital_signatures/digital_signature_private_keyset.json — ECDSA private key, typeUrl google.crypto.tink.EcdsaPrivateKey). Shor-vulnerable signatures; migrate to ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's constant-time MAC/tag comparison implementations (go/aead/subtle/aes_gcm_siv.go:141, go/mac/subtle/cmac.go:72 etc.) — a posture STRENGTH, not a weakness: Tink deliberately verifies MACs in constant time.

components.name: Go crypto/tls sessions on default settings (Go 1.20)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Go HashiCorp Vault KMS integration (go/integration/hcvault/hcvault_client.go and test) opens crypto/tls sessions with Go 1.20 default settings: TLS 1.2/1.3 with X25519 ECDHE key exchange — no post-quantum group offered, so captured vault traffic is harvest-now-decrypt-later. tls_sessions grades this B- (default settings, Go 1.20). Changeable here: bump Go toolchain and enable hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 once available (Go 1.24+), or terminate with a PQ-capative proxy.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Standalone ECDH agreement in Go hybrid encryption tests (go/hybrid/ecies_aead_hkdf_*_test.go) — computing the ECDH shared secret with X25519/P-256 via crypto/ecdh for ECIES verification. Shor-vulnerable key agreement; the production paths are covered by the X25519/P-256 objects. Test context.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency: golang.org/x/crypto pinned in go/go.mod provides curve25519/X25519 used by Tink's Go hybrid encryption and tests. Shor-vulnerable ECDH primitives are available to any Go code built from this module.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: NIST P-384/P-521 curve support: ECDSA key managers/templates (ES384/ES512 JWTs), ECIES point operations, hpke parameters and tests. Shor-vulnerable ECDSA/ECDH — migrate signatures to ML-DSA-65, key agreement to ML-KEM-768. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's primary recommended AEAD: AES-GCM key managers/templates/implementations across cc/go/java (5133 sites incl. tests) — quantum impact limited to key search (Grover), AES-128 to 128-bit vs quantum. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Experimental post-quantum SPHINCS+ (PQClean) signature key templates/managers in cc/experimental/pqcrypto/signature (sphincs_key_template.cc, signature_config.cc registers it) — hash-based, Shor-resistant; the PQ answer for signatures, not yet in the default registry. Library surface (experimental).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 variants of Tink's key templates (AES128-GCM, AES128-GCM-HKDF etc.) — Grover halves to 64-bit quantum security margin; Tink defaults are moving to AES-256. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Deterministic and CCM-family AEAD: AES-SIV (cc/daead/aes_siv_key.cc, keyset builder tests) and AES-CCM key managers. Misuse-resistant AEADs; symmetric — Grover-only impact. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC with SHA-256/384/512 key managers and templates (cc/aead/aead_key_templates.cc:171 HMAC streaming, mac/prf key managers) — symmetric MACs, Grover-only quantum impact. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Experimental post-quantum CRYSTALS-Dilithium signatures via PQClean (cc/experimental/pqcrypto/signature/dilithium_key_template.cc: Dilithium2/3/5 and AES variants) — the ML-DSA predecessor; Shor-resistant. Experimental branch, not in default registry; superseded by standardized ML-DSA (FIPS 204). Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+) support: cc/experimental/pqcrypto/signature/slh_dsa_parameters.cc:27 and key managers (BoringSSL-backed) — the standardized FIPS 205 stateful-hash signature; post-quantum-safe. Library surface (experimental branch).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHAKE/SHA-3 usage: SHAKE parameterization inside SPHINCS+ variants (sphincs_key_template.cc:320) and hash registries — extends the PQ signature parameter space. Symmetric primitives — Grover-only. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HKDF key derivation throughout Tink's hybrid encryption (ECIES AEAD-HKDF, CECPQ2 AEAD-HKDF recipient/sender KEMs) and streaming primitives. KDF, not key agreement — symmetric, Grover-only. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES block-cipher core usages in Go subtle (go/aead/subtle/aes_ctr.go, aes_gcm_siv.go and siblings) — the raw cipher underlying Tink's AEAD/MAC primitives. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Experimental FN-DSA (Falcon) lattice signatures via PQClean (falcon_key_template, falcon_sign_key_manager tests) — PQ-safe signatures, precursor to FN-DSA (draft). Experimental branch. Library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 variants of key templates (AES256-GCM, AES256-GCM-HKDF, AES256-SIV) — 256-bit keys retain 128-bit quantum security under Grover. Library surface.

properties.value: Declared module dependency: golang.org/x/crypto/chacha20poly1305 pinned in go/go.mod — the Go AEAD primitive package backing Tink's Go ChaCha20-Poly1305 implementations. Symmetric, Grover-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's experimental post-quantum signature stack built on PQClean: PQCLEAN_DILITHIUM2/3/5(+AES variants) via dilithium_subtle_utils, PQCLEAN_FALCON512/1024 via falcon_subtle_utils, PQCLEAN_SPHINCS+ (Haraka/SHA2/SHAKE robust+simple) via sphincs_subtle_utils — vendored PQClean C code reached through Bazel, experimental, not registered in the default Tink config. PQClean's pinned revision decides the hardness-parameters shipped. Library surface, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Tink's AWS KMS integration (cc/integration/awskms + go/java counterparts): remote AEAD envelope encryption where key material and algorithms live in AWS KMS — vendor-controlled, observable here; Tink templates only reference AWS key ARNs. Testdata holds dummy AWS credentials. Data-at-rest protection delegated to the cloud KMS.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's randomness layer: cc/subtle/random.cc:61 (BoringSSL RAND_bytes), Go crypto/rand wrappers, Java internal.Random backed by SecureRandom — the CSPRNG every key manager draws key material and nonces from. Strength depends on the platform DRBG (BoringSSL/OS).

Python integration tests connect with verify=False (recorded under ALG-a5f0697a).
